question: Should generic tool-progress intent become a supported public `ReplyPayload` plugin-SDK contract, or remain an internal runtime-owned delivery fact?
rationale: The PR adds public symbols and metadata semantics for third-party plugins to solve a Codex-to-Slack path; code correctness alone cannot authorize that permanent API boundary.

options.title: Approve generic public intent
options.body: Keep one documented generic marker and predicate that reusable producers and channel plugins can consistently honor.

options.title: Keep progress intent internal
options.body: Route the signal through an internal or runtime-only seam and remove the new public SDK exports.

recommendation.title: Approve generic public intent
recommendation.body: Keep one documented generic marker and predicate that reusable producers and channel plugins can consistently honor.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Slack native-data work makes this the strongest available owner for coordinating the channel behavior and permanent cross-boundary choice.
